_OBJECTIVE: Verify that S-band PSR (2.8 GHz) shows minimal Pd reduction in moderate rain. Paired with TC-04 (X-band) to isolate frequency-dependent ITU-R P.838-3 attenuation as the only test variable.
_PASS_CRITERIA: Pd drop < 5% at 100km vs TC-02 baseline. Quality > 80%. Track continuity > 90%.
_NOTE: S-band has low ITU-R P.838-3 attenuation. Uses sband_PSR.json (111 km rangeLimits) -- symmetric to xband_PSR used by TC-04 -- so the ONLY variable between TC-03 and TC-04 is CenterFrequency. Previously used default_PSR (20 km rangeLimits) which put targets at the edge of the range gate and confounded the frequency-vs-rain comparison.
description: TC-03: S-band PSR (2.8 GHz, symmetric geometry) in moderate rain (16 mm/hr) -- expect minimal degradation
